figures.shows: The editor's Console panel after 16 s of the Physics Playground's demo: the switches with Trace off, the filter box, and lines of the loggers Strata, App and Script, the warnings yellow
figures.caption: The Console panel shows the newest entries of the ring. Each line starts with its time in seconds and its logger, and its color gives its level: warnings are yellow. Trace is off, so trace lines are hidden.
figures.alt: The editor's Console panel. Above the list stand a Clear button, the switches Trace, Info, Warnings, Errors and Auto-scroll, all but Trace checked, and a filter box. Each line starts with a time in seconds and a logger in brackets: Script for the goal lines, Strata for yellow audio warnings, App for the editor's commands.
